title: Women's Horsebit Loafers - Black Calf
description: The beauty of a pair of calfskin handsewn loafers is they simply become your favorite pair of shoes. Each pair is handcrafted in Maine from the finest French calf hides that are tanned in Italy. Mimosa calf was specially designed to go through a five step process of antiquing and burnishing that gives each pair a unique beauty that you won't find anywhere else. The waxing and burnishing process brings out the high and low tones in the leather, further elevating the sophistication and attention to detail. Each pair is fully lined with tan cowhide lining and finished with a double leather soles that are oil treated for water resistance and extended durability. Genuine handsewn moccasin construction, each pair is sewn, by hand, on the last for the perfect fit. Made in Maine USA.
